title: Window opens mid-wave; T1 and T2 merged earlier appear only in a recap; T3 verified and merged in the window

# Wave 2 — billing-worker: retryable charge jobs

Rules
- One worktree per task; supervisor verdict ok=true required before merge.
- Tasks are sequential: each builds on the previous merge.

must_run:
- `go test ./internal/db/migrations/...`

must_run:

## T3 — Retry worker with capped exponential backoff

- `go test -race ./internal/retry/...`
- `go vet ./...`

## Done when
T1–T3 merged into main with ok verdicts.
